quotations.old_english: Sélre byð oft féðre þænne oferféðre
quotations.latin: meliora plura quam gravia honera fiunt
quotations.english: better is often loaded than overloaded

source_text: féþre; adj. Laden, loaded:--Sélre byð oft féðre þænne oferféðre better is often loaded than overloaded; meliora plura quam gravia honera fiunt, Angl. ii. 373. v. fóþor, féþrian.
